CSV-column to ROOT-entry transformation is not specified as a canonical mapping, including case/name conversion and whether the workbook index column is excluded solely by ENTRY_FIELDS.

matrix_artifact_hash in ROOT_OBJECT is not explicitly defined as the original workbook SHA256 versus a canonical extracted-row artifact hash.

Add exact CSV-column-to-entry mapping and value-normalization rules.
Bind the parsed source artifact identity and extraction transform to the declared workbook artifact, or provide the exact workbook bytes as the recomputation source.
